description: The bar chart, titled "PolitiFact," compares the accuracy (%) of a model under different conditions across two sets of experiments, with the y-axis representing accuracy ranging from 75.0 to 95.0 and the x-axis showing various experimental configurations. The left side of the chart displays results for a model with comments, showing an accuracy of 89.84% for "Ours," 86.82% for "w/o comments," 80.10% for "w/o text," 88.80% for "w/o select," 87.34% for "w/o emotion," and 87.17% for "w/o cognition." The right side of the chart presents results for a model without comments, with an accuracy of 90.57% for "Ours," 85.85% for "w/o comments," 83.02% for "w/o text," 89.62% for "w/o select," 84.91% for "w/o emotion," and 87.74% for "w/o cognition." The bars are color-coded: dark red for "Ours," orange for "w/o comments," light yellow for "w/o text," light blue for "w/o select," medium blue for "w/o emotion," and dark blue for "w/o cognition." The chart demonstrates that the "Ours" model consistently achieves the highest accuracy in both sets of experiments, with the highest accuracy overall being 90.57% in the "w/o comments" condition.
